title: Builds and releases
summary: Every merge to main is tested, built for Android and macOS, and published as the rolling latest release.
description: One release channel: installing the newest build is always the same download.

stories.want: the newest build always at one download link
a release that cannot upgrade installed apps to be stopped
stories.soThat: no learner is left unable to update

requirements.text: Every merge to `main` runs the tests, builds an Android APK and a macOS disk image, and replaces the rolling `latest` release.
A pull request runs the tests and compiles the Android and macOS apps, and publishes nothing.
Publishing waits for the tests to pass.
The Android APK is built for 64-bit and 32-bit ARM.
The macOS app is one universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel, ad-hoc signed and not notarized.
A release with any of the four Android signing secrets missing stops instead of publishing an APK that could not upgrade an installed app.
Pull request builds never use the release signing key.
The app's own code contains no unsafe Rust, and no `as` casts outside two float conversions; the lints fail the build otherwise.
